text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The long-awaited release day of the Carrotman collab tokusatsu movie! I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"The preview made the bad guy look super cool, nodaa!
He's definitely gonna steal the show, nodaa!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now, admission is starting soon.
No talking once the movie begins,
and mind your manners while eating popcorn!

text_block_list.name: Tokusatsu Hero
text_block_list.text:
"How dare you blow up bell pepper fields everywhere!
Sweet-tooth monster, face justice! Haaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweet-Tooth Monster
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaah... ah... I hate them... green peppers...
No one understands how I feel...
Stupid green peppers... I'm... I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to contain his hatred for bell peppers, the sweet-toothed monster committed an atrocity, his lonely cry echoing sorrowfully across the wasteland...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-What a bittersweet ending...
I had no idea the movie was going to be like this...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —It was totally boring! Neither the villains nor the heroes looked like they were having any fun! Pranks are supposed to be fun, that's why we do them!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: You kept hiding that you hated bell peppers all this time and couldn't tell anyone, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"......Was defeating them like that
really the right thing to do......?
The Sweet-Tooth Phantom was suffering, after all......"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hmm... That is a difficult question, isn't it...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
............Um, everyone. Tomorrow morning,
do you have some time before school starts?
I would love it if you could join me for my daily routine.

One morning at an intersection—Fenomeno was
gathering Haru Urara, Biko Pegasus,
and Shinko Windy together.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"This morning's mission is—
volunteering to watch over the students on their way to school!"

text_block_list.name: Little Kids
text_block_list.text: School commute monitoring volunteer...?
choice_data_list: I see, everyone's doing it together today.
I see, everyone's joining in today, huh?

text_block_list.text:
I often accompany her on these volunteer activities...
but today, she seems to have an agenda different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!! Everyone, please halt for a moment.
You all look full of energy today as well.

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Big Sis Fenomeno!
Listen, listen! Yesterday,
I learned how to recite the entire 7 times table!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That is wonderful! Keep up the good work.
If you ever run into trouble, make sure to talk to your teachers or parents. You're always welcome to come to me, too.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman A
text_block_list.text: You're always so full of energy. Hehe, it's quite charming.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! Oh, that's quite a load.
The roads around here are bumpy.
Please be careful handling that handcart!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno-san is making sure to chat with everyone while waving her flag, huh~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really feels like they're looking out for
the kids and the locals...
But why did they invite us?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So that no more kids turn into
Sweet-Tooth Monsters, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The ending of that movie... is a difficult issue.
Bearing loneliness and being driven into a corner until one turns
to villainy... is a very real thing.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Naturally, a wrong deed is still wrong. It must be judged.
Even so, but――――)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(To prevent a tragedy—
if there's anything I can do to stop it, I will!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: By always keeping an eye on the locals and engaging with them, you can notice when someone's in trouble. You can even offer them advice.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"If we do that—maybe we can reduce the number of people
who brood and suffer alone,
just like the Sweet-Tooth Fiend did..."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I firmly believe that accumulating small grassroots efforts is what leads to great justice, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Preventing evil deeds before people commit them.
For a hero, isn't that kind of activity equally important?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'll prevent... bad deeds...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: For example, one could choose to empathize with the Sweet-Tooth Kaiju's childhood hatred of bell peppers, to avoid a tragic conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. Yeah! I wanna do my best to eat bell peppers together with you!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
If you stay close to them like that, you'll make more
friends... and you can even play fun little pranks
together!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
――! If it's a fun prank,
Windy-chan is the absolute best at it!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Did that answer your question?
choice_data_list: I think that's a wonderful idea, Meno.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Fenomeno-senpai!
For the sake of justice, first comes flag-waving duty!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Or at least, that is how this officer sees it...
What are your thoughts on the matter...?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah. I still feel
really bad about the Sweet-Tooth Fiend's past,
and if I can save him, I want to!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Urara wants to eat bell peppers together with you! And with the Sweet Tooth Kaijin too!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Besides, pranks are better when they're fun!
So Windy-chan will just have to
become your prank master!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――Yes... yes!
I think that's wonderful. It would be great if everyone could reach out to the Sweet-Toothed Phantom!
"She must have thought long and hard about how to ease their worries. Seeing her growth brought a warm glow to my chest."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Does that answer your question?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
......Yeah.
It's not like everything's completely cleared up yet,
but... I feel like a path has opened up!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Indeed... This is a matter we must
steadfastly continue to contemplate.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Let us think together, for the sake of justice!
